Full-corpus exact join matched 701/715 unique keys across 702 auth events (701 Success, 1 Fail, 100% NTLM Network LogOn via destination_user); 14 unique keys unmatched (same-second alternate dst host in auth); 1 one-to-many key collision (2552687 U9263@DOM1 C17693->C828 Fail+Success).
known_limitations: Failed auth bias: fails recorded only for users with >=1 success in corpus; 701/702 (99.86%) matched positives are Success events.
4 source hosts total (C17693=701/749 annotations); chronological splits cannot avoid source-host overlap across Train/Val/Test.
Context shortcut risk: 100% of matched positives are NTLM Network LogOn.
Unmatched events mean unannotated enterprise background, not verified benign traffic.
lanl_rel_hour_mod24 is not true local wall clock and requires ablation.
Does not evaluate native Windows Event 4624/4625 or F1-F5 IP-keyed features.

datasets.qualification_rationale: Full stream integrity, join semantics, O(1) causal extraction, and chunked 11,039,825-row Parquet partitions with >=4.5-day/15.8-day separations are verified and reproducible; approved strictly for bounded offline Phase 3C benchmark experiments with explicit source-host/context shortcut and hour-ablation controls, while native Windows deployment remains BLOCKED.

schema_compatibility.notes: Uses flat JSON (`RecordNumber` instead of `EventRecordID`, lowercase `security` alongside `Security`, string `LogonType`, mixed short/FQDN `Hostname`). Parsed safely for schema/rule validation without fabricating missing values.

known_limitations: Too few auth samples (65 total 4624 and only 7 total 4625 across the 3 captures; <2 min windows prevent 5m/15m history warmup).
Mixed Channel capitalization (`security` vs `Security`) and mixed hostnames.
datasets.intended_role: Schema parsing, normalization fidelity, and deterministic rule/regression fixture validation only.
datasets.qualification_rationale: Genuine Windows Security 4624/4625 + Sysmon JSON telemetry under clear MIT license, verified passive schema edge cases, but strictly insufficient duration/sample count and no per-event labels for ML training.
